prTitle: feat(audit-trail): implement append-only tamper-detectable audit trail (#10)

criteria.check: AC1 audit-trail: appends an entry and returns it with a sequence number
AC2 audit-trail: numbers entries from one upwards with no gaps
AC3 audit-trail: refuses an entry timestamped before the previous one
AC4 audit-trail: chains each entry to its predecessor
AC5 audit-trail: reads the trail back in order and returns copies
AC6 audit-trail: filters by actor and by action, preserving order
AC7 audit-trail: redacts an entry target while keeping it in the chain
AC8 audit-trail: refuses to redact twice or to redact an unknown entry
AC9 audit-trail: rejects malformed entries, clocks and redactions
AC10 audit-trail: verify accepts an untampered trail, including a redacted one
AC11 audit-trail: verify detects a trail whose contents no longer match its chain
AC12 audit-trail: the trail is append-only: entries cannot be removed or reordered

oracleAccess.note: The agent can read acceptance/ and run `npm run acceptance`. A pass therefore means "converged against a visible oracle", not "was right without checking".
